title: Patient Payment Plans Setup Fee: Schedule of Account-Tenure Shares
content:
On the signing setup fee of a Patient Payment Plans plan, the tenure share follows how long the patient's Patient Financial Account has been open, counted in whole months from the date the account was opened to the signing date.

| Patient Financial Account opened, before the signing date | Tenure share of the setup fee |
|---|---|
| At least 120 whole months | 0.80 |
| At least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months | 0.90 |
| Fewer than 60 whole months | 1 |

**Rule.** The tenure share of the setup fee is 0.80 when the financial account was opened at least 120 whole months before the signing date, 0.90 when it was opened at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before, and 1 otherwise. The share multiplies the tier's setup fee within the scheduled setup fee, acting on the tier's setup fee itself; the scheduled setup fee is carried unrounded until the fee is entered.

**Record read.** The opened date of the Patient Financial Account.

**Boundaries (hypothetical dates).**

| Account opened | Signing date | Whole months | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2016 | 15 March 2026 | 120 | 0.80 |
| 15 March 2016 | 14 March 2026 | 119 | 0.90 |
| 15 March 2021 | 15 March 2026 | 60 | 0.90 |
| 15 March 2021 | 14 March 2026 | 59 | 1 |

**Figure (hypothetical fee).** On a hypothetical tier setup fee of 40.00, a share of 0.90 alone makes the scheduled setup fee 36.00.
